description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects selected SQL syntax in the Site header on init_consts.
affected_versions: Fortinet FortiClientEMS: 7.4.4; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects selected SQL syntax in the Site header on init_consts.
limitations: Other SQL dialects or injection shapes can bypass this heuristic. Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Legitimate tenant identifiers containing SQL punctuation may be denied.
